headline: QC and preprocessing tools for MS metabolomics and imaging data, with accessible front ends
label: Mass Spectrometry Quality Control
summary: New MS tools embed QC in metabolomics and MALDI-IHC workflows while MetaboLights updates its validation framework for repository-scale data reuse.
synthesis: The dominant thread is quality assessment applied to mass spectrometry outputs before interpretation or reuse. MetaboRx integrates quality metrics and preprocessing for LC-MS metabolomics feature tables, detecting formatting errors and unreliable features. gutenTAG addresses processing and QC of MALDI-IHC imaging data, using metapeak grouping of m/z bins to remain robust to mass shifts. MetaboLights describes a validation framework, submission workflow and Globus transfers for public metabolomics data at scale. Both MetaboRx and gutenTAG are open tools. Met4All and Breedbase pair QC with Shiny or integrated interfaces in methylation arrays and breeding data, extending the pattern beyond mass spectrometry. None of the mass spectrometry items is presented as a new identification algorithm; the contribution is in QC and validation infrastructure.
